themes.example: To ask the Secretary of State for Justice, what assessment he has made of the potential impact of Crown Court backlogs on the length of time defendants are held on remand prior to trial.

themes.subject: Immigration and settlement policy
themes.stance: probing government evidence base for proposed settlement reforms and visa thresholds
themes.example: To ask the Secretary of State for the Home Department, what assessment she has made of the potential impact of raising the language requirement for settlement from B1 to B2 on BNO visa holders.
